message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and an unforgettable performance by Jack Nicholson. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A chilling family drama that escalates into supernatural terror—perfect for a modern, unsettling experience. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Combines social commentary with genuine scares; it’s smart, tense, and still feels fresh. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silent tension, inventive sound design, and a heart‑wrenching story about survival. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head—beautiful yet disturbingly grotesque. |
| 6 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted paranormal thriller that balances atmosphere with jump‑scares. |
| 7 | **It Follows** (2014) | A unique premise that delivers constant dread and a haunting soundtrack. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood through a terrifying monster. |
| 9 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | A meta‑take on horror tropes that keeps you guessing until the very end. |
|10 | **The Ring** (2002) | A modern retelling of a Japanese classic that still feels creepy and relevant. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want the night to be. Happy watching!
